capabilities: Mark unreferenced attachments with a red dot in the file explorer
Jump from an attachment's context menu to all notes referencing it
Prefix referenced attachment names with the referencing note's name
Show referencing notes on hover over an attachment name
Toggle each of the three indicators independently
disambiguation: Not a cleanup or file-moving tool; it only marks and traces attachment references, it does not delete or relocate files.
extras: Community plugins listing is still under review; manual installation from GitHub Release is documented. Known issues: restart needed after install for red dots, slight delay with 1000+ attachments. Verified on Windows only; macOS, Linux, and Mobile are listed as theoretically compatible.
intentEvidence: Unreferenced attachments show a red dot in the file explorer for quick identification.
motivation: The README frames the goal as efficiently managing attachments and saying goodbye to file clutter and reference tracking issues.
problem: Obsidian's file explorer gives no way to see which attachments are unused or which notes reference a given file, leading to clutter and hard-to-trace links.
summary: File-explorer add-on that marks unreferenced attachments with a red dot and shows which notes reference each attachment.
